mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing baptismal water with a request to a saint was most worthwhile: it showed why an instrument analogy does not decide whether to address a departed person.

surprise.text: The bone investigation identified a specific missing connection between packet and casket, rather than treating the label as evidence of origin.
